note: Jordan: a non-Jordanian works on the Ministry of Labour's work permit, applied for by a licensed employer, for one year, six months or three months under the 2024 principles for workers with specialised skills. No performers' exemption was found, so no days.

sources.title: Ministry of Labour (Jordan), The Principles for Issuing Work Permits for Non-Jordanian Workers with Specialized Skills for the Year 2024
sources.said: The Ministry of Labor shall issue work permits for non-Jordanian Workers with Specialized ... The Ministry of Labor shall issue a work permit for a worker with specialized skills in the ... following categories: ... A work permit for a worker with specialized skills for three months.
